package rulefixtures

import (
	"fmt"

	"gorm.io/gorm"
)

// scenario for transaction_helper_outside_repository_or_uow_package: Transaction helpers buried in handlers or services instead of a repository or unit-of-work package.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
func WithTransaction(db *gorm.DB, fn func(*gorm.DB) error) error {
	tx := db.Begin()
	if tx.Error != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("begin tx: %w", tx.Error)
	}
	defer func() {
		if r := recover(); r != nil {
			tx.Rollback()
			panic(r)
		}
	}()
	if err := fn(tx); err != nil {
		tx.Rollback()
		return err
	}
	return tx.Commit().Error
}

type UserService struct {
	db *gorm.DB
}

func (s *UserService) CreateUser(name string) error {
	return WithTransaction(s.db, func(tx *gorm.DB) error {
		if err := tx.Exec("INSERT INTO users (name) VALUES (?)", name).Error; err != nil {
			return fmt.Errorf("insert user: %w", err)
		}
		return tx.Exec("INSERT INTO audit_log (action) VALUES (?)", "user_created").Error
	})
}
